description: This file defines a PHP interface named ConsoleConfigurationInterface within the namespace OrangeHRM\Framework\Console. The interface declares a single method, registerCommands, which takes a Console object as a parameter. It serves as a contract for classes that will implement console configuration functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ConsoleConfigurationInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface that mandates implementing classes to register console commands via the registerCommands method.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Declares a method to register commands to a Console instance. Must be implemented by classes adhering to this interface.

parameters.name: console
parameters.description: The console object to which commands will be registered.
